# Stat 3280 Final Project Code Only
### Alex Heyman
### 12/1/2025

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(ggridges)
library(readxl)
library(shiny)
library(shinyWidgets)
```

```{r}
nfl <- read.csv("NFL.csv")
excel_nfl <- read_excel("excelprojectdata.xlsx")
nflqbscsv <- nfl %>% 
  select(player_name, season, season_type, season_average_shotgun, season_average_qb_dropback) %>%
  filter(season_type == "REG")
  
nflqbscsv$season <- as.factor(nflqbscsv$season)
excel_nfl$season <- as.factor(excel_nfl$season)
nflqbs <- left_join(excel_nfl, nflqbscsv, by = c("player_name", "season"),
                    relationship = "many-to-many")
nflqbs <- nflqbs %>%
  filter(games_played_season >= 8, pass_attempts >=100)
nflqbs$season_type <- NULL
```

# Graph 1
```{r, warning=FALSE}
nflqbsg1 <- nflqbs %>%
  mutate(
    season_num = as.numeric(as.character(season)),
    year_bin = cut(
      season_num,
      breaks = c(2012, 2015, 2018, 2021, 2024, 2025),   
      labels = c("2012-2014", "2015-2017", "2018-2020", "2021-2023", "2024"), right = FALSE),
    over_five = season_average_rush_attempts >= 5)

facet_counts <- nflqbsg1 %>%
  group_by(year_bin) %>%
  summarize(count_over_five = sum(over_five))


graph1 <- ggplot(nflqbsg1, aes(x=season_average_pass_attempts, y=season_average_rush_attempts, color=over_five))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.7)+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("TRUE" = "blue", "FALSE" = "darkgrey"))+
  facet_wrap(~year_bin, ncol=5)+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(
    title="Avg Pass Attempts and Avg Rush Attempts by Bins",
    subtitle = "All quarterbacks with over five attempts per game are blue",
    x = "Average Pass Attempts per Game ",
    y= "Average Rush Attempts per Game",
    color = "Over 5 Attempts per Game:"
  )+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5,size = 9),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    strip.background=element_rect(fill="#AFCBFF80"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6)) +
  geom_text(
    data = facet_counts,
    aes(
      x = -Inf, 
      y = Inf,
      label = paste("QBs \u2265 5:", count_over_five) # looked up how to get the >= symbol
    ),
    hjust = -0.1,   
    vjust = 1.2,    
    size = 3,
    color = "black",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  )
graph1
```

# Graph 3

```{r, warning=FALSE}
nflqbsg2 <- nflqbs %>%
  select(player_name, games_played_season, season, pass_attempts, season_average_pass_attempts) 
graph2 <- ggplot(nflqbsg2, aes(x=season, y=season_average_pass_attempts))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.2, color = "black")+
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "text", aes(label = round(after_stat(y), 1)), 
               color = "darkred", vjust = 1.5, fontface = "bold", position = position_dodge(width = 0.75))+
  labs(
    title= "Boxplot of Average Pass Attempts by Season",
    y= "Season Average Pass Atempts",
    x = "Season"
  )+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
  
graph2
```

# Graph 4 - Plotly

```{r, warning=FALSE}
nflqbsg3 <- nflqbs %>%
  mutate(comp_bin = cut(comp_pct, breaks = c(0, 60, 65, 70, 75, 100),
                        labels = c("50-60%", "60–65%", "65–70%", "70–75%", ">75%")))

graph3 <- plot_ly(
  data = nflqbsg3,
  x = ~comp_pct,
  y = ~season_average_passing_yards,
  size = ~season_passing_yards,
  frame = ~season,
  color = ~comp_bin,
  type = 'scatter',
  mode = 'markers',
  marker = list(line = list(width = 1, color = 'black')),
  text = ~paste(
  "Player:", player_name,
  "<br>Season:", season,
  "<br>Avg Yards/Game:", round(season_average_passing_yards, 1),
  "<br>Total Passing Yards:", season_passing_yards,
  "<br>Completion %:", round(comp_pct, 1))
) %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text="Passing Yards Per Game and Completion Percentage", x=0.5),
    xaxis = list(title = "Completion Percentage"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Passing Yards Per Game"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Completion Percentages"))
  ) %>%
animation_opts(
    frame = 1500,      
    transition = 750)

graph3
```


# Supplemental Table
```{r summary-table, warning=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(knitr)
nflqbsg3_summary_neat <- nflqbsg3 %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_yards_per_game = round(mean(season_average_passing_yards, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    avg_completion_pct = round(mean(comp_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Season = season,
    `Avg Yards/Game` = avg_yards_per_game,
    `Avg Completion %` = avg_completion_pct
  ) %>%
  arrange(Season)
cat('<div style="font-size:12px; width:50%; ">')
knitr::kable(
  nflqbsg3_summary_neat)
cat('</div>')
```

# Graph 9 - Shiny App
```{r, eval=FALSE}
nflqbs <- nflqbs %>%
  mutate(season = as.numeric(as.character(season))) %>%
  left_join(playoff_qbs %>% mutate(made_postseason = "Yes"),
            by = c("season", "player_name")) %>%
  mutate(
    made_postseason = if_else(is.na(made_postseason), "No", "Yes")) %>%
  filter(games_played_season >= 8, pass_attempts >=100)
ui <- fluidPage(
  
  titlePanel("NFL Quarterbacks Visualization App"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      h4("Filters:"),
      h4("Dynamic Stats Summary"),
      verbatimTextOutput("dynamic_stats"),
    
      pickerInput(
        inputId = "season",
        label = "Select season(s):",
        choices = sort(unique(nflqbs$season)),
        multiple = TRUE,
        selected = unique(nflqbs$season),
        options = list(`actions-box` = TRUE, `live-search` = TRUE)
      ),
      radioButtons(
        inputId = "made_postseason",
        label = "Postseason Appearance",
        choices = c("Both" = "both", "Yes" = "Yes", "No" = "No"),
        selected = "both"
      ),
      h5("Graph 1 Filters:"),
      
      pickerInput(
        inputId = "highlight_qbs",
        label = "Highlight Quarterbacks:",
        choices = sort(unique(nflqbs$player_name)),
        multiple = TRUE,
        options = list(`actions-box` = TRUE, `live-search` = TRUE)
      ),
      
      selectInput(
        inputId = "fit_type",
        label = "Trend Line Type:",
        choices = c("Linear" = "lm", "Smooth" = "loess"),
        selected = "lm"
      ),
      
      h5("Graph 2 Filters:"),
      selectInput(
        inputId = "agg_method",
        label = "Aggregation Method:",
        choices = c("Mean" = "mean", "Median" = "median", "Total" = "sum"),
        selected = "mean"),
      selectInput(
        inputId = "plot_type2",
        label = "Plot Type:",
        choices = c("Line Chart" = "line", "Bar Chart" = "bar"),
        selected = "line"
      )
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      div(style = "text-align: center;", h4(textOutput("summary_text"))),
      plotOutput("plot1"),
      plotOutput("plot2")
    )
  )
)


server <- function(input, output){
  
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    data <- nflqbs
    data <- data %>% filter(season %in% input$season)
    
    if (input$made_postseason != "both") {
      data <- data %>% filter(made_postseason == input$made_postseason)
    }
    
    data <- data %>% mutate(highlight = if_else(player_name %in% input$highlight_qbs, "Yes", "No"))
    
    data
  })
  agg_fun <- reactive({
    switch(input$agg_method,
           "mean" = mean,
           "median" = median,
           "sum" = sum)
  })
  
  output$summary_text <- renderText({
    paste(
      "Number of Quarterbacks Matching Filters:",
      nrow(filtered_data())
    )
  })
  
  output$plot1 <- renderPlot({
    data <- filtered_data()
    
    ggplot(data, aes(
      x = season_average_rush_attempts,
      y = season_average_pass_attempts,
      color = made_postseason
    )) +
      geom_point(aes(alpha = highlight, size = highlight)) +
      geom_smooth(method = input$fit_type, se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
      scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Yes" = 1, "No" = 0.3), guide = "none") +
      scale_size_manual(values = c("Yes" = 5, "No" = 2), guide = "none") +
      labs(
        x = "Average Rush Attempts",
        y = "Average Pass Attempts",
        title = "Rush vs. Pass Attempts by Quarterbacks",
        color = "Made Postseason?"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "royalblue", "No" = "darkorange"))
  })
  
  output$plot2 <- renderPlot({
    data <- filtered_data()
    
    season_trends <- data %>%
      group_by(season, made_postseason) %>%
      summarize(avg_rush_att = agg_fun()(season_average_rush_attempts, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop")
    
    p <- ggplot(season_trends, aes(
      x = season,
      y = avg_rush_att,
      fill = made_postseason,
      color = made_postseason))
    
    if (input$plot_type2 == "line") {
      p <- p +
        geom_line() +
        geom_point(size = 2)
    } else {
      p <- p +
        aes(x=factor(season))+
        geom_col(position = "dodge", width=0.5)
    }
    
    p +
      labs(
        title = "Average QB Rush Attempts by Season",
        x = "Season",
        y = "Average Rush Attempts",
        color = "Postseason?",
        fill = "Postseason?"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "royalblue", "No" = "darkorange")) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "royalblue", "No" = "darkorange"))
  })
  
  
  
  output$dynamic_stats <- renderPrint({
    data <- filtered_data()
    
    reg_yes <- data %>% filter(made_postseason == "Yes")
    reg_no  <- data %>% filter(made_postseason == "No")
    
    safe_mean <- function(x) round(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
    
    cat("Summary for Current Years Selected:\n\n")
    cat("Made Postseason:\n")
    cat("  • Avg pass attempts/game: ", safe_mean(reg_yes$season_average_pass_attempts), "\n")
    cat("  • Avg rush attempts/game: ", safe_mean(reg_yes$season_average_rush_attempts), "\n\n")
    cat("Did NOT Make Postseason:\n")
    cat("  • Avg pass attempts/game:", safe_mean(reg_no$season_average_pass_attempts), "\n")
    cat("  • Avg rush attempts/game:", safe_mean(reg_no$season_average_rush_attempts), "\n")
  })
}


shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```

# Graph 10/11
```{r, message=FALSE}
nflqbsg8 <- nflqbs %>%
  mutate(season = as.numeric(as.character(season))) %>%
  left_join(playoff_qbs %>% mutate(made_postseason = "Yes"),
            by = c("season", "player_name")) %>%
  mutate(
    made_postseason = if_else(is.na(made_postseason), "No", "Yes"),
    made_postseason_num = if_else(made_postseason == "Yes", 1, 0),
    season_num = as.numeric(as.character(season)),
    season_bin = cut(x = season_num,                             
      breaks = c(2012, 2017, 2021, 2025),   
      labels = c("2012-2016", "2017-2020", "2021-2024"),
      right = FALSE)
  )
baseline_data <- nflqbsg8 %>%
  select(season_average_rush_attempts, made_postseason_num, season_average_pass_attempts)

graph8 <- ggplot() +
  geom_smooth(data = baseline_data, aes(x = season_average_rush_attempts, y = made_postseason_num, color = "Baseline"),
    method = "loess",se = FALSE, alpha=0.5) +
  geom_smooth(data = nflqbsg8, aes(x = season_average_rush_attempts,y = made_postseason_num, color = season_bin),
    method = "loess",se = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("2012-2016"="chocolate", "2017-2020"="violet", "2021-2024"="cornflowerblue", "Baseline"="grey"))+
  labs(
    title = "Probability of Making Playoffs vs Avg Rush Attempts",
    x = "Avg Rush Attempts per Game",
    y = "Probability of Making Playoffs",
    color = "Era"
  )+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
graph8
graph9 <- ggplot() +
  geom_smooth(data = baseline_data, aes(x = season_average_pass_attempts, y = made_postseason_num, color = "Baseline"),
    method = "loess",se = FALSE, alpha=0.5) +
  geom_smooth(data = nflqbsg8, aes(x = season_average_pass_attempts,y = made_postseason_num, color = season_bin),
    method = "loess",se = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("2012-2016"="chocolate", "2017-2020"="violet", "2021-2024"="cornflowerblue", "Baseline"="grey"))+
  labs(
    title = "Probability of Making Playoffs vs Avg Pass Attempts",
    x = "Avg Pass Attempts per Game",
    y = "Probability of Making Playoffs",
    color = "Era"
  )+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
graph9
```

# Graph 12 - Shiny
```{r, eval=FALSE}
nflqbs <- nflqbs %>%
  mutate(season = as.numeric(as.character(season))) %>%
  left_join(playoff_qbs %>% mutate(made_postseason = "Yes"),
            by = c("season", "player_name")) %>%
  mutate(
    made_postseason = if_else(is.na(made_postseason), "No", "Yes"),
    pass_ypa = season_average_passing_yards / season_average_pass_attempts,
    rush_ypa = season_average_rushing_yards / season_average_rush_attempts,
    td_int_ratio = if_else(interception == 0, TD, TD / interception)) %>%
  filter(games_played_season >= 8, pass_attempts >=100)
ui <- fluidPage(
  
  titlePanel("Quarterback Efficiency and Playoff Appearance"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      h4("Filters"),
      selectInput("season", "Select Seasons:",
                  choices = sort(unique(nflqbs$season)),
                  selected = unique(nflqbs$season), multiple = TRUE),
      
      
      
      selectInput("eff_metric", "Efficiency Metric:",
                  choices = c(
                    "Completion %" = "comp_pct",
                    "Passing Yards per Attempt" = "pass_ypa",
                    "Rushing Yards per Attempt" = "rush_ypa",
                    "TD/INT Ratio" = "td_int_ratio"
                  )),
      selectInput("plot_type2", "Plot Type:",
                  choices = c("Scatter Plot" = "scatterplot",
                              "Box Plot" = "boxplot")),
      selectInput("highlight_qbs", "Highlight Quarterbacks (Scatter Plot Only):",
                  choices = sort(unique(nflqbs$player_name)),
                  multiple = TRUE),
      selectInput("trend_type", "Trendline Method (Scatter Plot Only):",
                  choices = c("Linear"="lm", "Smooth"="loess"),
                  selected = "loess")
      

    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      div(style="text-align:center;", h4(textOutput("summary_text"))),
      plotOutput("scatter_plot"),
      verbatimTextOutput("dynamic_summary")
    )
  )
)
server <- function(input, output, session){
  
  filtered_data <- reactive({
    nflqbs %>%
      filter(season %in% input$season) %>%
      mutate(highlight = if_else(player_name %in% input$highlight_qbs, "Yes", "No"))
  })
  
  output$summary_text <- renderText({
    paste("Number of Quarterbacks Matching Filters:", nrow(filtered_data()))
  })
  
  output$scatter_plot <- renderPlot({
    data <- filtered_data()
    metric_label <- c(
      comp_pct = "Completion %",
      pass_ypa = "Passing Yards per Attempt",
      rush_ypa = "Rushing Yards per Attempt",
      td_int_ratio = "TD/INT Ratio"
    )[input$eff_metric]
    if (input$plot_type2 == "scatterplot") {
      ggplot(data, aes(
        x = season_average_pass_attempts,
        y = !!sym(input$eff_metric),
        color = made_postseason
      )) +
        geom_point(aes(alpha = highlight, size = highlight)) +
        geom_smooth(method = input$trend_type, se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
        scale_alpha_manual(values = c("Yes" = 1, "No" = 0.3), guide = "none") +
        scale_size_manual(values = c("Yes" = 5, "No" = 2), guide = "none") +
        labs(
          x = "Average Pass Attempts",
          y = c(comp_pct = "Completion %",pass_ypa = "Passing Yards per Attempt", 
                rush_ypa = "Rushing Yards per Attempt", 
                td_int_ratio = "TD/INT Ratio")[input$eff_metric],
          color = "Made Postseason?",
          title = paste("QB", metric_label, "vs Workload (Pass Attempts)")
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
      
    } else {
      ggplot(data, aes(
        x = factor(season),
        y = !!sym(input$eff_metric),
        fill = made_postseason
      )) +
        geom_boxplot() +
        geom_jitter(aes(color = made_postseason), width=0.1, alpha = 0.5, show.legend=FALSE)+
        labs(
          x = "Season",
          y = c(comp_pct = "Completion %",pass_ypa = "Passing Yards per Attempt", 
                rush_ypa = "Rushing Yards per Attempt", 
                td_int_ratio = "TD/INT Ratio")[input$eff_metric],
          fill = "Made Postseason?",
          title = paste("Distribution of", metric_label, "by Season")
        ) +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(face="bold", hjust=0.5))
    }
  })
  output$dynamic_summary <- renderPrint({
    data <- filtered_data()
    
    reg_yes <- data %>% filter(made_postseason == "Yes")
    reg_no  <- data %>% filter(made_postseason == "No")
    
    cat("Efficiency Summary by Postseason Status:\n\n")
    cat("Made Postseason:\n")
    cat(" - Avg", c(comp_pct = "Completion %",pass_ypa = "Passing Yards per Attempt", 
                    rush_ypa = "Rushing Yards per Attempt", 
                    td_int_ratio = "TD/INT Ratio")[input$eff_metric], ":", mean(reg_yes[[input$eff_metric]], na.rm=TRUE), "\n\n")
    cat("Did NOT Make Postseason:\n")
    cat(" - Avg", c(comp_pct = "Completion %",pass_ypa = "Passing Yards per Attempt", 
                    rush_ypa = "Rushing Yards per Attempt", 
                    td_int_ratio = "TD/INT Ratio")[input$eff_metric], ":", mean(reg_no[[input$eff_metric]], na.rm=TRUE), "\n")
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
